gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-display: Noto Sans Display gives every word a tall middle zone, while Flavors draws its letters with a blunt, round-tipped marker feel. Page after page, it stays friendly and unhurried, never tiring the eye.
gen-flavors-gf-play: Whimsical neon-tube letters glow through Flavors, each held to a single steady line. And the standout quality is how Play's body quietly shifts its line weight, a faint nudge between upstrokes and downstrokes.
gen-flavors-gf-port-lligat-sans: Flavors keeps every arm and leg at a constant width. Port Lligat Sans packs its sans-serif characters close as pins in a cushion, so paragraphs settle into a dense, smooth texture.
gen-flavors-gf-ramabhadra: Flavors looks drawn with a ruler and compass, every line precise and playful, with diagonals as hefty as its stems. Ramabhadra, a sans-serif with prominent x-height, feels like its quieter sibling.
gen-flavors-gf-rambla: Rambla's small letters nearly match its capitals in height. Beneath Flavors and its constant-weight outlines, this plain sans carries paragraph after paragraph smoothly, with a clean, unfussy rhythm.
gen-flavors-gf-recursive: Recursive is a friendly, modern sans with a tall mean line and strokes that hold width in every direction. But the strongest quality here is Flavors itself, whimsical and commanding with its stubby, towering x-height.
gen-flavors-gf-roboto-condensed: A towering, stubby-pencil x-height gives Flavors a whimsical, commanding presence that fills the whole line. And Roboto Condensed, a plain sans with tight, wire-smooth lines, does the quiet work of holding text compact.
gen-flavors-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Saira Semi Condensed reads like magnified text at normal size, a modern sans with a steady weight from word to word. Flavors supplies the whimsy, making the gap in character the strongest thing here.
gen-flavors-gf-secular-one: Flavors stands on a towering, stubby-pencil x-height. It handles the whimsy and the commanding shout, while Secular One, a plain sans with a dominant midsection and no stroke modulation, handles the talking.
gen-flavors-gf-smooch-sans: Commanding lowercase towers over the page in Flavors, while Smooch Sans packs its high midline into tightly spaced lines. Both stand tall, one loud and playful, the other tidy and compact.
